questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the given clause structure to emphasise the subject’s unexpected action?
options: It was not until she had finished her report that she realised the deadline had passed.
Only when she had finished her report did she realise the deadline had passed.
She realised the deadline had passed only when she had finished her report.
When she had finished her report, she realised the deadline had passed.
questions.answer: Only when she had finished her report did she realise the deadline had passed.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to express the idea that ‘the most important factor in success is hard work’?
options: What matters most in success is hard work.
The most important factor in success is hard work, which is essential.
It is hard work that is the most important factor in success.
Success is achieved through hard work, but other factors also play a role.
questions.answer: It is hard work that is the most important factor in success.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret about a past decision?
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have cancelled my plans.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have gone to the meeting.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have been disappointed.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have invited you instead.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have cancelled my plans.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis with a relative clause to maintain coherence in a formal academic context?
options: The study, which was conducted by the team, found significant results.
The study, which was conducted by the team, found significant results, which were surprising.
The study found significant results, the team having conducted it.
The team conducted the study, which found significant results.
questions.answer: The study, which was conducted by the team, found significant results.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of a formal register with a passive construction and a nuanced conditional clause?
options: Had the proposal been approved, the project would have started immediately.
The project would have started immediately if the proposal was approved.
Approval of the proposal was essential; otherwise, the project would not have begun.
The project would have been delayed if the proposal was not approved.
questions.answer: Approval of the proposal was essential; otherwise, the project would not have begun.
